text:
sarah (sales): Quick thread 1 - Spectral (reseller) wants a 10-day co-sell POC: eu-west hosting, SAML SSO, telemetry to their S3, and a pricing sketch (hosted PAYG vs short dedicated). Also they submitted a short security questionnaire.

maria (partner-eng): From partner: 2 admin accounts + 3 readers, IdP metadata (entityID + ACS), preferred region eu-west, and optional KMS ARN for encrypted telemetry.

aj (solutions): Pricing sketch (very rough): assume 120k tokens/day -> 1.2M tokens for 10 days. Hosted PAYG @ $0.0009/token -> ~$1,080. Short Dedicated commit could be ~25% cheaper depending on model; VPC+KMS adds setup costs. Ill put exacts in sheet.

timo (infra): SAML binding ready. For KMS we accept customer CMK ARN for telemetry encryption on Dedicated/private. VPC peering or on-prem HSM requires 20 days lead.

Liam (Spectral): Thanks! Can you give a minimal checklist we can fill now so kickoff isn't blocked? Also need sample SAML metadata.

maria (partner-eng): One-pager checklist: 1) company domain/IdP metadata XML 2) admin emails (2) + test users 3) tokens/day estimate 4) telemetry S3 ARN + cross-account role ARN 5) KMS ARN if used 6) preferred region 7) legal contact for pen-test OK. Will DM SAML sample.

ops-bot: Staging tenant provisioned: spc-spectral-stg-1123 (tenant_id: spc-1123). Upload IdP metadata to tenant to complete SSO binding.

anna (legal): Security Qs: SOC2 Type II available; pen-test allowed under authorization window (we'll provide template). Data residency in eu-west confirmable for POC. Legal ticket created: LEG-8330.

sarah (sales): AJ please produce 1-slide hosted vs dedicated vs vpc+kms with per-token assumptions before kickoff. Maria, schedule 30m kickoff with Spectral.

aj (solutions): Will post spreadsheet by EOD with model SKU options and fallback routing example to control cost.

maria (partner-eng): Kickoff invite sent for tomorrow 09:00 CET. Infra ticket INF-4710 opened for cross-account role and SAML binding. Leaving thread open for updates.

Liam (Spectral): Perfect 1 well upload metadata and admin list now. Thanks everyone.
